'''Volume 8''' is the eighth of ten volumes of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]].

==Blurb==
''Meet Apricot, the Ninja Girl! In contrast to the hapless Walnut, Apricot is one of the most skilled ninjas around. The two of them are childhood friends, and apparently Apricot carries a torch for Walnut! Unfortunately because Apricot always bullies Walnut (unknowingly), he is absolutely terrified of the fiery ninja girl. Will love blossom between the two of them?''

==Important events==
* [[Apricot]], [[Marimaru]] and [[Madam Azumarill]] are introduced.
* [[Walnut]] meets the "Afternoon Angel", a girl who visits his [[Walnut Tree|parents' bakery]] daily who is really Apricot.
* {{TP|Coconut|Eevee}} and [[Lu]] go on a date.
* [[Coconut]] meets {{p|Vulpix}} and {{p|Cyndaquil}} for the first time.
* Apricot starts to develop a crush on Walnut.
